description: Extracts a structured candidate profile from a resume (PDF, DOCX or scanned image)

fieldSchema.name: CandidateProfile
fieldSchema.description: Structured profile of a job candidate taken from their resume

CandidateName.description: Full name of the candidate, usually the large heading at the top

Location.description: City and province/state where the candidate lives

Headline.description: The candidate's current or most recent job title

Skills.description: Every technical skill, tool or technology listed in the resume's Skills section, one per item, exactly as written. Keep multi-word names together as one item (e.g. 'NIST CSF', 'Azure Data Factory')

Certifications.description: Professional certifications listed in the Certifications section only, written exactly as they appear. Do not include degrees, diplomas or bootcamp certificates from the Education section. Empty if there is no Certifications section

WorkHistory.description: Each job in the Experience section

StartDate.description: Start month and year as written, e.g. Mar 2023

EndDate.description: End month and year as written, or Present

TotalYearsExperience.description: Total years of professional experience, calculated by adding up the duration of every job in the work history (treat Present as October 2026; do not count gaps between jobs). Round to the nearest whole year

Education.description: Each degree, diploma or certificate program in the Education section

RoleFamily.description: The candidate's primary career track based on their titles and skills

MentionsDateOfBirth.description: True if the resume states the candidate's date of birth or age

MentionsMaritalStatus.description: True if the resume states the candidate's marital status

MentionsPhoto.description: True if the resume contains a photo of the candidate or a [Photo] placeholder
